title: Follow published progress from local Git

intentCoverage.report:
# Dough Intent Coverage

**Verdict — Caught.** The maintained test caught a stale watched-branch head in the durable Board confirmation after a successful revisit to origin confirmed the branch was absent.

The checked revision was `a1aee15796d919e1d1c37e28dfc1aef1bbdc5b1d` on `codex/follow-published-progress-from-local-git`. SEED-430's published-progress story promises that a failed probe keeps the last confirmed branch state and time, and a successful probe that finds a branch gone confirms its absence. [Story](https://github.com/terryyin/open-dough/blob/a1aee15796d919e1d1c37e28dfc1aef1bbdc5b1d/.planning/seeds/SEED-430-read-published-project-data-from-local-git.md#follow-published-progress-from-local-git) · [Plan](https://github.com/terryyin/open-dough/blob/a1aee15796d919e1d1c37e28dfc1aef1bbdc5b1d/.planning/slice-plans/823-follow-published-progress-from-local-git/PLAN.md)

The one scratch fault made `verifiedBoardBranches` look up the former confirmed head when the origin's advertised heads omit a branch. The fixture and assertions were identical in all runs. The fixture creates a real Git origin, publishes `story/one`, deletes its ref, temporarily makes origin unreachable, then restores the same origin. [Fault location](https://github.com/terryyin/open-dough/blob/a1aee15796d919e1d1c37e28dfc1aef1bbdc5b1d/dashboard/server/verifiedBoardBranches.ts#L99) · [Maintained test](https://github.com/terryyin/open-dough/blob/a1aee15796d919e1d1c37e28dfc1aef1bbdc5b1d/dashboard/backend-tests/observation/authenticated-read-verified-branches.spec.ts#L98)

All three runs used the same command in a detached scratch checkout with Node 24.21.0 and the locked dependencies installed.

```sh
caffeinate -s -i npm run test:dashboard:backend -- authenticated-read-verified-branches.spec.ts --grep 'a failed probe preserves a deleted branch' --workers=1 --reporter=line
```

- **Baseline.** One named case passed.
- **Fault.** Playwright's trace records that the earlier assertions passed, including the failed probe's HTTP 502, the exact former durable record, and HTTP 200 after origin returned. The maintained assertion at line 149 then failed. The test's independent read of the on-disk Board confirmation returned `story/one` at its former SHA `16f16eddda6165a2eafec60895d47288fadef4b3` where the branch's head should have been `null`. [Catching assertion](https://github.com/terryyin/open-dough/blob/a1aee15796d919e1d1c37e28dfc1aef1bbdc5b1d/dashboard/backend-tests/observation/authenticated-read-verified-branches.spec.ts#L146-L153)
- **Restored.** Git matched the clean pre-probe state before and after replay. The same case passed, and the scratch worktree was removed.

**Next proof action.** No change for the observed path. The check detected stale branch state at the durable confirmation boundary.

- **Test runtime.** Measured in seconds. Playwright reported 8.6 s for baseline and 3.8 s after restoration. The fault trace recorded 2.972 s for the case including hooks.
- **Human effort.** Unavailable because the scratch runs had no measured human interaction.
- **Agent effort.** Unavailable because no separate agent effort counter was available.


- **Invocation-to-report elapsed.** 135168 ms (measured), from 1795859651702 to 1795859786870 in Unix epoch ms. The end clock was sampled after writing the prepared report body.

Wrap-up disposition — a1aee15796d919e1d1c37e28dfc1aef1bbdc5b1d, Caught. No proof follow-up for the checked path.
